BEFORE YOU DESCEND

Field guide.

Each level has one answer. Solve it to unlock the next transmission. Spaces, punctuation, and letter case are ignored.

  1. The page itself is part of the puzzle. Some clues require interaction or inspecting the page. Desktop is recommended.
  2. Keep paper nearby. Later levels combine more than one technique.
  3. There are no hints. Research, notes, and external tools are welcome. There is no timer.
  4. Hard Edition progress stays in this browser and is separate from the old 12-level edition. Clearing browser storage removes it.

These are original puzzles inspired by the puzzle-hunt format. Difficulty increases as you descend. This is a solo, browser-based game, with no account or competitive leaderboard.
